content.short: Blaize.Security is a blockchain auditing company and Web3 security provider.
content.description: Blaize.Security offers comprehensive blockchain and smart contract auditing services, employing cutting-edge tools and methodologies to help create a secure foundation for blockchains and decentralized applications. With more than five years in the field, Blaize has partnered with over 15 ecosystems and completed upwards of 120 security audits, delivering thorough assessments that identify vulnerabilities and strengthen code quality. The team's experience spans multiple networks, enabling rigorous, industry-standard security practices.
